title: Deterministic sensitivity and tornado analysis
primary_chapter_title: Decision Modelling, Simulation, and the Value of Information
purpose: Tests how one uncertain input at a time changes net monetary benefit or another linear decision outcome and ranks decision drivers.
input: `Parameters` sheet with parameter, base, low, high; `Model` sheet with intercept and coefficient for each parameter.
outputs: Low/base/high outcome for each parameter, ranked impact table, tornado chart, and threshold-risk summary.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
